title: Fun, simple, esthetic app
body: I like this app. It’s simple. Super simple…. Fun animations. Nice color coded way to keep track of habits. I just wish it had more features to justify the yearly price.
author: KingsofMan

title: The best!
body: An app I genuinely love, and recommend to everyone. It even educates you on the science of habits. I've formed many habits successfully thanks to this app. Literally my favourite!
author: tmurny
